summary: Mississippi Forestry Commission's 100 ft Aermotor tower in Yalobusha County, registered 2022 and called well preserved; no build history found.

notes_for_editor: Thin sources: only the NHLR register page and an OSM node. No build year, designer, staffing, fire history, or access statement was found, so the story says so. The record's material 'steel' (material_from design) is not stated on the register page; Aermotor towers are steel, but this is unverified here. Record elevation 114.3 m matches the register's 375 ft (114 m); OSM gives 112 m. The register's site-visit note has the typo 'Site vist'. Two web searches and about five page reads found no MFC history of this tower; a human could check MFC records or the 2022 NHLR photos.
